items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Well, Charlie wouldn't release me to go to Fate. So, I had to stay up still with Charlie on the boat.

ctx.x: Well, Charlie wouldn't release me to go to Fate. So, I had to stay up still with Charlie on the boat. You see, during that time, but then Charlie was beginning to make his band, bring his band more of between a New Orleans style and a St. Louis style. So, you had the New Orleans St. Louis style and the St. Paul, and you had the straight Dixieland New Orleans style with a Fate Man or Boydichess. And that's the way St. Louis wanted it.

What was there much difference in what you call the St. Louis style? And... No, no, no. Anything special about the St. Louis players? I've heard Charlie Crep is a wonderful blues player. That's right, you see. He's really exceptional on the blues.
